text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto spends her days desperately chasing after T.M. Opera O. Meanwhile, a new star is born at Hanshin Racecourse.
She is Admire Vega, a stoic racer of few words. Her running today staunchly puts her in the leading role for the Classics.
One day, at Tracen Academy, Meisho Doto collides into Admire Vega in the hallway. However…
Admire Vega doesn't budge an inch. The sheer strength in her legs sends a clear message to Meisho Doto—her skills are on another level.
